---
name: Feature or integration
about: Propose one bounded product feature with reuse-first evaluation
title: "[Feature] "
labels: []
assignees: []
---

## User problem and priority
What problem does this solve? P0 / P1 / P2?

## Acceptance criteria
List observable behavior and tests, including failure cases.

## Existing functionality
What exists today in this repository? How was this verified?

## Reusable public components
Links, exact versions/commits, licenses, maintenance/security findings.

## Proposal
Keep existing / install package / integrate service / adapt licensed component / custom build. Why?

## Security, privacy and cost
Data access, auth boundaries, external service usage, per-session spend.

## Smallest PR scope
Describe one testable vertical slice; identify explicit non-goals.

## Evidence needed before closing
Runnable example, tests, docs and feature-matrix update.
